name: Silicone scar sheets

lead: Silicone scar sheets are adhesive, reusable sheets of medical-grade silicone applied over a healed scar for most of the day for weeks to months. They are used for raised hypertrophic scars and keloids, and are sometimes applied after surgery or acne.
They are a standard first-line, non-invasive option and an inexpensive way to treat a visible scar.

paras: Silicone hydrates the outer skin layer and is thought to regulate fibroblast activity and collagen production through occlusion and gentle pressure, softening and flattening the scar.

Side effects are rash, itching or maceration, and sheets must be kept clean. Cochrane reviews describe the evidence as limited and low to very low certainty, with trials of poor quality, though some show improved thickness and color. Reported benefits are modest, and consistent wear is required.
